q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
## Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution**
Today is 2026-08-13. NVIDIA is expected to release Q2 FY2027 earnings around August 26, 2026. Approximately 13 days remain until the earnings release and forward guidance announcement.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why**

The most direct evidence comes from NVIDIA's own forward guidance: they explicitly provided Q2 FY2027 revenue guidance of **$91.0 billion ±2%** during their Q1 FY2027 earnings call on May 20, 2026.

This means the guidance range is $89.18B to $92.82B ($91.0B × 0.98 to $91.0B × 1.02).

The question asks what guidance NVIDIA will *provide* in the Q2 earnings release, not what actual Q2 revenue will be. When a company provides forward guidance in an earnings call, that guidance typically represents their best estimate at that time. The most likely scenario is that NVIDIA will either:
- Reaffirm this guidance (if execution is tracking as expected)
- Slightly adjust it (±$1-2B range)

Given that only ~2.5 months have passed since the guidance was issued, and there's no indication in the research of major disruptions or changes, a modest adjustment or reaffirmation is most probable.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Unexpected weakness in demand or AI market saturation concerns
- Supply chain disruptions or yield issues
- Macro weakness or customer pushback on capex spending
- China revenue restrictions proving more severe than anticipated
- Competitive pressures materializing (AMD, others)
- Guidance conservatism to set up beats (common practice)

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Better-than-expected data center demand continuing to accelerate
- Strong customer commitments leading to upward revisions
- Potential for China revenue to re-emerge if restrictions ease
- Market share gains versus competitors
- Operating leverage and pricing power in the current market
- Potential for accelerated AI adoption driving forward bookings

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values**

The research provides NVIDIA's own forward guidance: **$91.0 billion ±2%** issued May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027.

The analyst consensus range is $90.3B to $96.7B (median $91.8B), which brackets the company guidance slightly above it.

Historical pattern: Tech companies typically adjust guidance incrementally (±2-5%) between quarters unless major changes occur. Large moves are rare when only 2.5 months have passed.

---

## Reasoning

NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance of $91.0B ±2% for this quarter. With only 13 days until earnings and no reported major disruptions, the probability that their actual guidance will fall near their previously stated range is very high.

The most likely scenario (60%+ probability) is that NVIDIA either:
1. Reaffirms the $91.0B guidance
2. Makes a modest upward adjustment to ~$92-94B (given analyst consensus is higher at $91.8B)
3. Makes a modest downward adjustment to ~$89-91B (if being conservative)

The range $89.18B to $92.82B represents their stated ±2% tolerance. Moves beyond $96.7B would require very strong upside surprise. Moves below $89B would signal significant demand concerns.

Given the tight timeframe and the explicit prior guidance, I'm anchoring heavily on the stated $91.0B ±2% range, with slight bias toward a modest upward adjustment given analyst consensus sits at $91.8B and the market remains strong for AI infrastructure.

The distribution should be concentrated around $89-94B with tails extending modestly beyond.

Low (10th percentile): 88500000000
Median (50th percentile): 91500000000
High (90th percentile): 94500000000
q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA released its Q1 FY2027 earnings on May 20, 2026, reporting record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA provided strong forward guidance, expecting revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This figure is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). NVIDIA explicitly stated that this outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). The company also anticipates GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0%, respectively, for Q2 FY2027 [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Analysts' consensus revenue estimate for Q2 FY2027 is $91.8 billion, with a range of $90.3 billion to $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates). NVIDIA is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings around August 26, 2026 [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates).
